title: Fastjson 1.2.24 Deserialization RCE
description: A Java web application that parses request bodies with Fastjson 1.2.24, vulnerable to deserialization through @type: a JSON body can name a class such as JdbcRowSetImpl, whose setters make a JNDI lookup to the player's RMI or LDAP server.
question: Exploit the Fastjson 1.2.24 autoType deserialization to run commands on the server and read /ctf/flag.
